9 September 2026
Six ERC Starting Grants for Ghent University in an increasingly competitive funding landscape
Six researchers have been awarded a prestigious ERC Starting Grant, reaffirming the university's strong position in European research. Despite the European success rate falling further to 8.8%, Ghent University achieved a success rate of almost 20%.
